name: WARNING: Applebee's Boneless Buffalo Wings (Battered, Fried & Spicy)
whyItWorks: Chicken breast pieces coated in thick wheat batter, deep-fried in commercial fryer oil, and tossed in spicy classic Buffalo cayenne pepper sauce. The intense capsaicin and fryer oil cause mucosal spasms and watery diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid all battered and buffalo-sauced wings. Stick to unbattered, plain grilled chicken.
